overview: Analyze 600519.SS Q4 2025 financial performance and generate a research report with citations.
research_topic: 分析 600519.SS 2025Q4 财务表现，并生成带引用的研究报告
requirements: 覆盖收入、利润率、现金流、风险、市场表现和近期新闻
所有关键结论必须绑定 evidence_id
输出 Markdown、HTML、JSON、trace 和验证报告

tasks.description: Fetch market snapshot and recent news for 600519.SS covering Q4 2025 market performance and news events.
tasks.expected_output: Market data (price, volume, returns) and news summaries with source URLs.

tasks.description: Retrieve financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) for 600519.SS Q4 2025 and prior quarters for trend analysis.
tasks.expected_output: Structured financial data with evidence IDs for each figure.

tasks.description: Compute financial ratios (revenue growth, gross margin, net margin, operating cash flow, free cash flow) and trend analysis for 600519.SS Q4 2025.
tasks.expected_output: Evidence-backed claims and tables for revenue, profitability, and cash flow.

tasks.description: Analyze risk factors (debt-to-equity, volatility, beta, liquidity ratios) and market performance (relative to index) for 600519.SS Q4 2025.
tasks.expected_output: Risk assessment claims and market performance summary with evidence IDs.

tasks.description: Assemble all analyzed claims, evidence, and news into a structured research report covering revenue, profitability, cash flow, risks, market performance, and recent news. Output Markdown, HTML, JSON, and trace.
tasks.expected_output: Complete report in all required formats with citations integrated.

tasks.description: Verify all material factual claims in the report have explicit evidence_id citations, no unsupported numbers or ratings, and consistent formatting. Generate validation report.
tasks.expected_output: Validation report indicating pass/fail and any issues.
